### Motivation

This workflow is based on cleaning the `antigen-selected` databases (Ex: `S19`, `S20`, `S21`). 

To select the best members of each `antigen-selected` cluster, we need to find and draw information from the clonal family members in the `source databases` (library or cDNA). It is the distinctions between `antigen-selected` members and `source members` of each clonal family that is critical.

Because we cannot expect the highly-enriched and selected VHHs in the antigen-selected databases to always have closely related CDR3 regions, we need a new method to identify clonal families in the source databases from which they originated. 

This will be addressed in subsequent experiments, likely by comparing consensus CDR3s, median CDR3s, and median VHHs in clonal families.

### Construct Dataset with Initial Statistics for Cleaning

**We want:**

1. `CDR3-entropy`

2. `VHH-entropy`

3. `median-CDR3` 

5. `CDR3-consensus`

4. `median-VHH`

```
unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
```


```{r, eval = T, echo = T}
results <- data.frame()

system.time(
for (nm in cdb$cluster_id){
  if (nm %in% intersect(cdb$cluster_id, db$clone_id)){
  tmp_frame <- db[db$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
  
  ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
  unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
  
  CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
  VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
  
  # Pull most frequent CDR3 and VHH
  median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
  median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
  consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
  
  # Pull entropy values
  CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
  VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
  
  ## Subset variables of interest
  
  tmp_frame$median_VHH_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(median_VHH, tmp_frame$VHH))/nchar(median_VHH))*100
  tmp_frame$median_CDR3_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(median_CDR3, tmp_frame$junction_aa))/nchar(median_CDR3))*100
  tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(consensus_CDR3, tmp_frame$junction_aa))/nchar(consensus_CDR3))*100
  
  tmp_frame$median_CDR3 <- rep(median_CDR3, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  tmp_frame$median_VHH <- rep(median_VHH, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3 <- rep(consensus_CDR3, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  tmp_frame$CDR3_entropy <- rep(CDR3_entropy, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  tmp_frame$VHH_entropy <- rep(VHH_entropy, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  
  results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
  }
}
)
rm(tmp_frame, unrolled_CDR3s, unrolled_VHHs)
```

## Rule-based Cleaning (CDR3 length and Homology)

*	10 aa CDR3, `>60%` homology within databases selected on the same target?
  
*	6-9 aa CDR3, `>80%` homology within databases selected on the same target? (or combine CDR1/2/3 together and >60% homology?)
  
*	<6 aa CDR3, `100%` homology? (or combine CDR1/2/3 together and >60% homology?) 

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
tmp_res <- data.frame()
cleaning_run <- "Rule-Based"

for (nm in cdb$cluster_id){
  if (nm %in% intersect(cdb$cluster_id, results$clone_id)){
      tmp_frame <- results[results$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]

      
      # Pull values for constraints
      consensus_CDR3 <- tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3[1]
      median_VHH <- tmp_frame$median_VHH[1]
    
      ## Enforce Constraints
      if (nchar(consensus_CDR3) >= 10){
        tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology >= 60,]
      } else if ((nchar(consensus_CDR3) > 6) & (nchar(consensus_CDR3) < 10)){
        tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology >= 80,]
      } else {
        tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[(tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology == 100) | 
                                         (tmp_frame$median_VHH_homology >= 90 & tmp_frame$consensus_CDR3_homology >= 80),]
      }
      
      
      if (nrow(tmp_frame) >= 1){
          ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the duplicates
          unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
          unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
          # Pull most frequent CDR3 and VHH
          median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
          median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
          consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
          # Pull entropy values
          CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
          VHH_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_VHHs)
          # Count duplicates
          duplicate_count <- sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count)
          # Bind together results
          tmp_res <- rbind(tmp_res, cbind(tmp_frame$f[1], 
                                          tmp_frame$clone_id[1],
                                          duplicate_count,
                                          consensus_CDR3,
                                          median_CDR3,
                                          median_VHH,
                                          CDR3_entropy,
                                          VHH_entropy))
          colnames(tmp_res) <- c("File",
                                 "clone_id",
                                 "duplicate_count",
                                 "consensus_CDR3",
                                 "median_CDR3",
                                 "median_VHH",
                                 "CDR3_entropy",
                                 "VHH_entropy")
    }
  }
}

tmp_res$id <- rep(cleaning_run, each = nrow(tmp_res))

#tmp <- rbind(tmp, tmp_res)
```

```{r}
df <- db[,c("sequence_id", "clone_id", "junction_aa", "duplicate_count")]
```



```{r}
# Function to find the most frequent string in a clone_id group
find_most_frequent_string <- function(junction_aa) {
  frequencies <- table(junction_aa)
  most_frequent <- names(frequencies)[which.max(frequencies)]
  return(most_frequent)
}

# Function to filter and separate strings based on similarity threshold
filter_strings <- function(df, threshold = 0.8) {
  filtered_df <- data.frame()
  retained_df <- data.frame()
  df$median_CDR3 <- rep("", each = nrow(df))
  
  unique_clone_ids <- unique(df$clone_id)
  
  # Iterate over all clonal families
  for (clone_id in unique_clone_ids) {
    # Look at one clonal family
    subset_df <- df[df$clone_id == as.numeric(clone_id), ]
    # Pull the median (while accounting for duplicates)
    most_frequent_string <- find_most_frequent_string(unroll_dupes_fast(subset_df, "junction_aa"))
    # Store the medians
    subset_df$median_CDR3 <- rep(most_frequent_string, each = nrow(subset_df))
    # Calculate similarities
    similarity <- 1 - (as.numeric(calculate_levenshtein(most_frequent_string, subset_df$junction_aa))/nchar(most_frequent_string))
    # Store results based on the threshold
    retained_df <- rbind(retained_df, subset_df[similarity >= threshold,])
    filtered_df <- rbind(filtered_df, subset_df[similarity < threshold,])
  }
  
  return(list(retained_df, filtered_df))
}

# Example usage
# Assuming 'df' is your data frame containing the provided data

# Cluster and filter strings
result <- filter_strings(df, threshold = 0.8)

# Separate retained and filtered data frames
retained_df <- result[[1]]
filtered_df <- result[[2]]

# Print retained and filtered data frames
print("Retained Data Frame:")
print(retained_df)
print("Filtered Data Frame:")
print(filtered_df)

rm(result)
```

This leaves us with a `retained_df` (which obeys all constraints), and a `filtered_df`, whose data needs to be re-clustered.

Our goal, here, is to update `filtered_df` with the correct clonal assignments, and then rbind to retained df.


```{r}
results <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(filtered_df)){
  if (i %% 1000 == 0){
    cat("Currently on row: ", i, '\n', sep = '')
  }
  # Pull the junction_aa in question
  o_junction_aa <- filtered_df$junction_aa[i]
  # Check if there is an exact match
  if (any(retained_df$median_CDR3 == o_junction_aa)){
    # If there is an exact match, pull it
    tmp_frame <- retained_df[which(retained_df$median_CDR3 == o_junction_aa),]
    # We only need the first observation
    tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[1,]
    # Now we update the filtered value with its clone_id and median CDR3
    filtered_df$clone_id[i] <- tmp_frame$clone_id[1]
    filtered_df$median_CDR3[i] <- tmp_frame$median_CDR3[1]
    # Now add it to the retained df
    retained_df <- rbind(retained_df, filtered_df[i,])
    
    # Drop it from filtered df
    
    # filtered_df <- filtered_df[filtered_df$clone_id != tmp_frame$clone_id, ]
  } else {
    
    # Calculate similarities
    similarity <- 1 - (as.numeric(calculate_levenshtein(o_junction_aa, retained_df$junction_aa))/nchar(retained_df$junction_aa))
    
    # Find closest match based on homology, and assign it to the group
    if (any(similarity >= 0.80)){
      # Subset the most similar observation
      tmp_frame <- retained_df[which.max(similarity),]
      # Assign its data to the filtered df observation
      filtered_df$clone_id[i] <- tmp_frame$clone_id[1]
      filtered_df$median_CDR3[i] <- tmp_frame$median_CDR3[1]
      # Add the observation to retaind df
      retained_df <- rbind(retained_df, filtered_df[i,])
      
      
      # Drop the observation from filtered_df
      # filtered_df <- filtered_df[filtered_df$clone_id != tmp_frame$clone_id, ]
      
    # If there is no closer match, we make a new group
    } else {
      tmp_frame <- rbind(retained_df, filtered_df)
      new_clone_id <- max(as.numeric(tmp_frame$clone_id))+1
      # Now we update the filtered value with its clone_id and median CDR3
      filtered_df$clone_id[i] <- new_clone_id
      filtered_df$median_CDR3[i] <- o_junction_aa
      # Add the observation to retained df
      retained_df <- rbind(retained_df, filtered_df[i,])
      
      # Drop the old observation
      # filtered_df <- filtered_df[filtered_df$clone_id != new_clone_id, ]
    }
  }
  
}
```
